title: PhysForge: Physically Grounded Interactive 3D Asset Generation
summary: PhysForge is a research framework for generating simulation-ready 3D assets with functional parts and kinematic constraints. It utilizes Vision-Language Models for blueprinting and a specialized diffusion mechanism to synthesize physically consistent geometry and interactive logic.
research_notes: Collaboration between HKU and Tencent Hunyuan; specifically designed for robotic manipulation and embodied AI simulators.

evolution.summary: Accepted to ICML 2026. The project is currently transitioning to open-source with the release of the PhysDB dataset containing 150,000 physically annotated assets.
